notes.title: HOT UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hello community, we have just released a large update that changes the game a lot! New features and plot elements will bring you better game experience.

Here's the changelist:

[list]
[*] Added Collection items. Collect all items to craft magic stuff for the mage. This will help him become human again. Incredible!
[*] Added Daily Quests
[*] Added Character Skins
[*] Added character and item effects
[*] Changed menu icons
[*] Improved character controls (now you can jump from the edge of the platform without being afraid of falling into lava)
[*] Changed springs. Also, now they are animated.
[/list]

Have nice holidays!

notes.title: We released a new location – Sands World!
notes.content:
An update for Just Bones is finally out! It takes the main character to desert. He needs to outsmart mummies, try not to die in the quicksand and go ahead.

Mummies do not let you get past them unless you give them the body part they need. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25157350/78399ba3363856ea5771e291d9a272b0ba31365b.gif[/img]

Sand is an unstable surface that can make you fail, so be careful!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25157350/f8646bc025be126eabcc8af849239430c1b35aa2.gif[/img]

[list]
  [*] 15 levels with new mechanics.
  [*] Mummies won’t let you get past them unless you give them body parts they need. 
  [*] Watch your step: sand platforms are very unstable. 
  [*] Fixed character control bugs.[/list]

notes.title: Just Bonus Track, a free DLC for all Just Bones players
notes.content:
Hello dear Just Bones players,
We've receieved really warm feedback about sound in "Just Bones Flashback" video. That is the reason why we've prepated our first DLC ever - the full version of that track. The track was created by DenDerty, and it is available to all Just Bones owners for free. Enjoy!

Here's the link: http://store.steampowered.com/app/515990

notes.title: We've created Just Bones' flashback!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi there![/h1] 
Many players told that Just Bones is a good game, but one cannot understand its plot without reading the game description. We wanted to fill this gap and created this video. Hope, you'll like it!
Comments are welcome! ːsteamhappyː
https://youtu.be/k5-ITPH4gow

notes.title: Hey guys!
notes.content:
We decided on the release date. It will happen on June 9. Currently we’re fixing bugs so that you could fully enjoy it. 

Also, we added collectible cards, badges and achievements, since we know that many players adore them. We hope you’ll like them.

Moreover, we realized that for making sure the game is more fun, there should be a possibility to play with gamepad.

Thanks for finding us!
